_note: Founder lines for a scripted demo with the sample dossier (Nimbus Freight). Each is voiced in a male voice and sent on the subject channel.
lines: Thanks for having me. So, we're about 200 people now across Bengaluru and Pune.
Honestly, we tripled the team this year. Demand has been crazy.
Before Nimbus I was VP of Engineering at Flipkart, from 2018 to 2021.
Kavya and I worked together at Flipkart for years before starting Nimbus.
We've raised about 14 million dollars so far, and Peak Harbor led our Series A.
Aur abhi hum 30 engineers hire kar rahe hain.
